subject: Mathematics
title: Quadratic Formula & Discriminant Analysis
description: Fundamental algebraic formula giving roots of any second-degree polynomial equation $ax^2 + bx + c = 0$.
examTrap: Always ensure $a \neq 0$. If $D < 0$, roots are complex conjugates: $x = \frac{-b \pm i\sqrt{|D|}}{2a}$.
shortcuts: If $a + b + c = 0$, roots are $x_1 = 1$ and $x_2 = c/a$
Sum of roots $x_1 + x_2 = -b/a$, Product of roots $x_1 x_2 = c/a$
phoneticReadout: x equals minus b plus or minus square root of b squared minus 4 a c, all over 2 a

subject: Mathematics
title: Euler's Formula & Identity
description: Establishes the fundamental relationship between trigonometric functions and complex exponential functions.
examTrap: Angle $\theta$ MUST be in radians, never degrees! When $\theta = \pi$, $e^{i\pi} = -1$.
phoneticReadout: e to the i theta equals cosine theta plus i sine theta

subject: Computer Science
title: Master Theorem for Divide & Conquer Recurrences
description: Provides asymptotic time complexity bounds ($O, \Theta, \Omega$) for divide-and-conquer algorithm recurrences.
latex: T(n) = a T\left(\frac{n}{b}\right) + f(n), \quad a \ge 1, b > 1

variables.a: Number of subproblems in recursive step
variables.b: Factor by which input size is divided
variables.f(n): Cost of work done outside recursive calls

examTrap: Master Theorem CANNOT be applied if $a$ is not constant, or if $f(n)$ is non-polynomial (e.g. $2^n$).
derivationSummary: Compare f(n) against n^{\log_b a}: Case 1: T(n) = \Theta(n^{\log_b a}), Case 2: T(n) = \Theta(n^{\log_b a} \log n), Case 3: T(n) = \Theta(f(n))
shortcuts: Binary Search: $T(n) = T(n/2) + O(1) \implies O(\log n)$
phoneticReadout: T of n equals a times T of n over b plus f of n

subject: Computer Science
title: AMAT (Average Memory Access Time)
description: Measures total effective memory latency across multi-level cache hierarchies (L1, L2, Main Memory).

variables.AMAT: Average Memory Access Time in nanoseconds ($ns$)
variables.Miss Rate: Fraction of memory accesses that miss L1
variables.Miss Penalty: Latency to fetch block from L2 or Main Memory

examTrap: Miss Penalty for L1 is the FULL AMAT of L2, NOT just Main Memory latency alone!
shortcuts: In 2-Level Cache: $\text{AMAT} = t_{L1} + m_{L1}(t_{L2} + m_{L2} t_{\text{main}})$
phoneticReadout: Average Memory Access Time equals L1 hit time plus L1 miss rate times L1 miss penalty

subject: Physics
title: Newton's Second Law of Motion
description: Fundamental law governing net external force, momentum rate of change, and acceleration of a body.
examTrap: Formula holds ONLY when mass $m$ is constant! For variable-mass systems (e.g. rockets), use $F = \frac{dp}{dt} = m\frac{dv}{dt} + v\frac{dm}{dt}$.
shortcuts: Inclined plane: Parallel force $F_{\parallel} = mg \sin\theta$, Normal force $N = mg \cos\theta$
phoneticReadout: F vector net equals mass times acceleration vector
